scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Patent Registration
other_conditions: Enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) as applicable
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of publication/notification of the patent
benefits_summary: Financial support covering up to 75% of patent registration costs, with a maximum assistance of ₹25,00,000 per applicant/enterprise.
